intro: I’m currently pursuing my MSc in Marketing at the University of Edinburgh Business School, where I’m exploring the intersection of consumer psychology, cultural influences, and strategic brand development. My academic interests centre on understanding not just what drives consumer decisions, but how identity, experiences, and evolving cultural narratives shape the relationships people build with brands. Building on my professional experience, I’m particularly interested in translating consumer insights and qualitative research into thoughtful, culturally relevant marketing strategies that connect creativity with meaningful impact.
subHead: in my previous role at Archer Lewis as a Marketing Operations Associate
subHead2:

statement: At Archer Lewis, most of my job was making sure 35 firms could market themselves without running

bio.text: Each firm at Archer Lewis had its own market and its own clients, but they shared a brand. So most of the work was building something once and making it hold up everywhere it landed.
At VML I worked on organic search for Ford.com. Mostly keyword and competitor research, written up as recommendations the content teams could use.
Before that: four internships across social, product marketing and creative. Small teams, so I got to do a bit of everything.

seoDesc: MSc Marketing student at the University of Edinburgh Business School. Previously marketing operations at Archer Lewis, supporting 35 accounting firms, and organic search for Ford.com at VML.
